why: No major reviewer or authority answers this; the one famous name (Digital Camera World) is a laptop power-bank roundup. The closest pages are niche spec calculators and roundups: homepowerfacts sizes for the Standard dish rather than the Mini, ryzzun and offgridfieldguide cover the Mini alone without the laptop, yourpowersetup gives Wh math without products, and the rest are a brand store, a retailer and general guides. A focused page with Mini + MacBook runtimes on named stations, prices and a pick would stand out.
